title: Mushroom Edibility Detector
cardDescription: An interactive web-based game where users compete against a convolutional neural network to classify mushroom images as edible or poisonous
modalDescription: The project combines a PyTorch-trained image classification model with a lightweight web interface that presents random mushroom images, collects user guesses, and displays both human and model predictions alongside running scores. By framing model inference as a quiz-style experience, the platform provides an engaging way to explore computer vision performance while highlighting uncertainty, safety considerations, and common failure cases in automated biological classification.

title: NBA Court Geometry Modeling
cardDescription: Redesigning the NBA court dimensions to restore offensive strategic diversity
modalDescription: This AISC Winter project investigates how changes to NBA court geometry can be used to counter modern three-point inflation and restore stylistic balance in professional basketball. Using historical NBA shot-tracking and player performance data, the project uses machine-learning probability models to estimate points per game with respect to changing 3 point arc radiuses and individual player shot selection as functions of court dimensions. We then built artificial intelligence simulations to investigate how 5v5 team oriented basketball would play under different court dimensions.

title: MediRare
cardDescription: MediRare is a multimodal AI system that mines medical literature figures and case reports to surface hidden misdiagnosis patterns in rare autoimmune diseases.
modalDescription: MediRare is a multimodal AI system that mines medical literature figures and case reports to surface hidden misdiagnosis patterns in rare autoimmune diseases. It combines computer vision to extract insights from published medical figures, NLP to map misdiagnosis trails from PubMed case reports, and an LLM reasoning agent to connect signals across diseases generating research-ready reports for clinicians and scientists. The system targets rare autoimmune conditions like Lupus, Sjögren's, and MCTD where patients wait 6+ years for a correct diagnosis.

title: AscendQuiz
cardDescription: Put any PDF you want to make into a quiz you can study!
modalDescription: A quizzing app that converts any PDF into an adaptive, mastery-based quiz. An AI analyzes the uploaded document and uses its knowledge base to generate a quiz that adjusts to the quiz-taker’s level, and assesses based on “mastery” instead of a grade. Designed for education, but can be used with any document.

title: HealthLink
cardDescription: This project is a symptom tracking dashboard that lets users log how they’re feeling over time through a simple interface.
modalDescription: This project is a symptom tracking dashboard that lets users log how they’re feeling over time through a simple interface. The system organizes entries into visual timelines and identifies trends in symptom frequency, severity, and potential triggers. An AI component then generates concise, doctor-ready summaries that turn unstructured logs into clear, actionable insights.

title: GCH - drug Side effect predictor
cardDescription: This project aims to create a model that can predict drug side effects in specific patients without the need for clinical trials.
modalDescription: This project aims to create a model that can predict drug side effects in specific patients without the need for clinical trials. The model received information about a specific patient (age, weight, sex, blood_type, medical_history, ect) as well as certain drug (along with its chemical structure) as input. Then, using transformer neural networks it outputs a list of side effects the patient can potentially experience along with a probability for each one.

title: CI Failure Intelligence System
cardDescription: An AI system that analyzes CI/CD workflows and logs to predict failures, identify root causes, and discover recurring failure patterns over time.
modalDescription: The system models pipelines as structured workflows, learns from historical runs, and uses both log signals and workflow context to localize the true origin of failures and understand how they propagate. It then provides actionable insights, including explanations, fix suggestions, and long-term pipeline improvements to reduce future failures.

title: Fluorescent Image Analysis/ Coral Identification
cardDescription: This project is a collaboration with Dr. Wangpraseurt's lab at Scripps Institute of Oceanography - the task is to automate coral segmentation/identification using 3D photogrammetry model data.
modalDescription: In collaboration with Dr. Wangpraseurt's lab at Scripps Institute of Oceanography, the project team is automating coral segmentation/identification using 3D photogrammetry model data. Using the Open3D python library, they are developing a pipeline that can distinguish coral tissue from substrate and algae growth, crop/isolate individual coral colonies, and export isolated coral 3D models for morphological analysis.

title: Website Development
cardDescription: The development of this website! It was made with NextJS, Typescript, Tailwind, and love.
modalDescription: This project involves our website development! It was made with NextJS, Typescript, Tailwind, and love. The website serves as a platform to showcase our projects, share updates, and connect with the community. It is designed to be user-friendly and visually appealing, providing an engaging experience for visitors.
